parts.text: During a radio programme, a company of biscuit manufacturers once asked listeners to bake biscuits and send them to their factory. bake 用烤炉、烤箱去烤 They offered to pay $10 a pound for the biggest biscuit baked by a listener. for 等价交换、付款, 赔偿; 付出代价 The response to this competition was tremendous. the response to ... is / was tremendous / lukewarm 对…的反应是巨大的/不温不火的 造句：The university offered a prize of $1,000 to the first student who would find a solution to the problem. The response to the competition was tremendous / lukewarm. 学校提供了一笔1000美元的奖金给第一个能解决这个问题的学生。大家对这次比赛的反应很热烈/很平淡。 Before long , biscuits of all shapes and sizes began arriving at the factory. before (very / too) long 不久之后 all sorts / kinds / types of sth. 各种各类 造句：She has to deal with all kinds of complaints every day. 她每天必须要处理各种各样的投诉。 One lady brought in a biscuit on a wheelbarrow. It weighed nearly 500 pounds. 主系表 A little later, a man came along with a biscuit which occupied the whole boot of his car . The largest was 713 pounds. The largest weighed 713 pounds. But just before the competition closed , a lorry arrived at the factory with a truly colossal biscuit which weighed 2,400 pounds . It was so heavy that a crane had to be used to remove it from the lorry. 造句：The box was so heavy that a lorry had to be used to carry it to the destination. 箱子太沉了，用了一辆卡车才把它运到目的地。 造句：In the past two years many shops have been set up in the street.两年多来这条街上新开了很多商店。 The manufacturers had to pay more money than they had anticipated , for they bought the biscuit from the student for $24,000. buy from 从某处购买
